brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Provide a compact modular storage structure to keep sewing supplies tidy on a desk/shelf
requirements.evidence: 5-cell cluster (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full + piece:-1,0,0;full + piece:1,-1,0;full) joined with 4 connectors and 2 joint bolts, capped faces - stable desktop organizer ~360mm across

requirements.requirement: Provide divided compartments for small notions (buttons, pins, bobbins, thread)
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) and bin:1,-1,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) give 6 small compartments - staged with pen, marker, tweezers, pencil, heap-nuts-div3 and heap-screws-div3 as button/bead proxies

requirements.requirement: Provide larger/open compartments for tools and tape/scissors
requirements.evidence: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full open tray holds tape measure (prop:1) standing visible; bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 provide 2-compartment trays for brushes, tape-electrical (thread spool proxy) - all visible in look az45 polar62

Staged with workshop/desk props as proxies (tape measure, ruler-proxy brush, tweezers for scissors, cable-coils/tape for thread, heaps for buttons) - no sewing-specific props exist in catalog (find_props sewing/thread/button returned 0), so proxies used; materials/strength not verified - 3D-printed plastic, fit only

finish.summary: Built a 5-cell Hex Cluster sewing caddy with 5 bins: 1 open, 2x 2-compartment and 2x 3-compartment trays. Caps and joint bolts lock the cluster. Staged with tape measure, brushes, tweezers, pens/markers and small-parts heaps as sewing-supply proxies - catalog has no dedicated sewing props. Check_build clear, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
